products.name: Workday AI
products.note: HR and finance AI; skills-based talent; predictive analytics; sensitive HR data exposure

profile_text.body:
Workday is a public enterprise software company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Pleasanton, California. According to its website, the company positions itself as an enterprise AI platform for HR, finance, and IT. Workday describes offering what it calls Sana and agentic AI, enabling teams of specialized agents to perform key processes across those functions. The company states its AI can activate agents to find, build, act, and automate workflows while supporting and empowering employees.

The company's main tracked AI product is Workday AI, which focuses on HR and finance capabilities including skills-based talent management and predictive analytics. Workday reported revenue of $9.552 billion for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026. The company is a public filer with the SEC under CIK 0001327811 and trades under ticker WDAY.

The held facts reflect significant litigation exposure. Workday faces multiple employment-related lawsuits in federal district courts across California, Georgia, North Carolina, Colorado, Maryland, and Virginia. California accounts for 220 cases in the dataset. Cases include Meckfessel Poletti v. Workday, Inc., Williams v. Workday, Inc., Elias v. Workday, Inc., Hill v. Workday, Inc., and others, primarily in the Eastern District of California.
